name: Sohrab Ahmari

lean.basis: Neoconservative writer (Wall Street Journal opinion pages, Commentary) who criticized Trump, Putin and Le Pen as part of a global illiberal trend.

Turned to post-liberal "common-good" conservatism ("Against David French-ism", 2019), backed Trump and Orbán, and served as an adviser to Vice President JD Vance; combines social conservatism with pro-worker economics.

current_role: US editor of UnHerd; founding editor of Compact; adviser to Vice President JD Vance
summary: Sohrab Ahmari (born 1985 in Tehran) is an Iranian-American writer and editor, formerly op-ed editor of the New York Post. A convert to Catholicism, he broke with "David French-ism" in 2019 and became a leading post-liberal voice; in 2022 he co-founded the magazine Compact. Wikipedia describes him as an adviser to Vice President Vance in Trump's second term; in June 2026 he flew with Vance to Switzerland for talks with Iran without a security clearance.

timeline.role: Co-founder and founding editor (with Matthew Schmitz and Edwin Aponte)
